name: proof-ledger-and-explicit-failures
rationale: The executable Gherkin ledger, fresh-environment references, result schema, collection guard, explicit-failure drivers, and protected hollow mutations are one proof boundary; separating the harness would create a completion-free infrastructure change.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when all 47 outlines collect into the classified matrix, selected and executed cases agree, empty or swallowed success is non-success with no effects, evidence resolves on a clean host, and fixed-success mutations turn both cells red.
nonGoal: Does not treat catalog state, a process exit, skipped work, or fixture-only evidence as behavior completion.

name: public-formats-and-artifact-lineage
rationale: Version negotiation and immutable artifact identity meet at persisted public references, so their registries, migrations, retention assertions, and compatibility tests form one multi-file contract slice.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when every supported format version has one negotiated meaning and immutable hash lineage survives reload, authorized retention, expiry, collision, mutation, and incompatible-version cases.
nonGoal: Does not add a compatibility shim or retain eligible private material indefinitely.

name: deployment-and-clean-host
rationale: Installed-package lifecycle and the closed deployment-input boundary share initialization, readiness, migration, diagnostics, update, rollback, and secret-handling paths; proving them together avoids a package-only fragment.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when a clean supported host installs, initializes, provisions fonts, runs every public command, updates and rolls back, while extra or malformed inputs and secret leakage fail before readiness and reruns recover safely.
nonGoal: Does not add a deployment input, require repository knowledge, or hide a failed dependency behind a successful doctor result.

name: identity-and-access
rationale: Session identity, memberships, grants, seats, revocation, tenant isolation, and audit share transactions and authorization resolution; one coherent service/database/API test slice is a reviewable access-control change.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when local and federated identities yield opaque revocable sessions, every access mutation commits with one audit event, forged or cross-tenant authority fails, and revocation denies immediately.
nonGoal: Does not let provider roles, billing state, cached UI state, or resource discovery grant product authority.

name: privacy-and-commit-authority
rationale: Disclosure authority, custody boundaries, one-use grants, commit-time revalidation, and no-effect losing races are one security invariant across storage, provider, publication, and transaction seams.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when private evidence remains resolvable only to authorized actors, public derivatives are non-reconstructive, forbidden egress and storage stay empty, and stale, replayed, revoked, raced, or claim-changed actions leave no artifact, receipt, charge, or message.
nonGoal: Does not claim an authorized plaintext recipient cannot see plaintext or let redaction authorize its own publication.

name: catalog-refresh-and-selection
rationale: Provenance-preserving refresh, conflict evidence, local scan upsert, exact release selection, ambiguity, readiness, and work scope use one catalog repository and read-model boundary.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when interrupted and repeated refreshes preserve provenance and privacy, while exact, ambiguous, unknown, detector-only, conflicting, and stale release queries produce the declared selection and scope without guessed identity.
nonGoal: Does not turn fuzzy discovery, detector confidence, or inaccessible records into owned-release authority.

name: locale-branch-and-policy
rationale: Locale-branch creation and versioned localization policy share source revision, branch scope, normalized surfaces, persisted settings, conflict handling, and isolation transactions.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when repeated branch creation is idempotent, different locales stay isolated on one immutable source revision, and required surface, locale, provider, style, budget, and asset policy conflicts fail or persist exactly as declared.
nonGoal: Does not synthesize locale identity, inherit another branch's mutable state, or dispatch policy by engine name.

name: source-and-locale-knowledge
rationale: Cited source facts, frozen locale ground truth, context invalidation, and authorized precedent reuse share immutable snapshots, scope, citations, branch compatibility, and privacy filters.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when required source facts and citations are complete, each locale binds a frozen compatible context, changes invalidate only the dependency cone, and exact or fuzzy precedent never crosses project, branch, locale, source, or authority boundaries.
nonGoal: Does not infer missing facts from translations or expose private precedent through similarity search.

name: run-policy-accounting-and-entrypoints
rationale: Run admission, physical provider attempts, exact accounting, and command/HTTP/rendered parity converge on one durable policy and injected workflow boundary; bundling prevents entrypoints from silently diverging.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when only complete permitted policy starts work, every physical attempt records requested and served identity, privacy posture, tokens, latency and cost, and all supported entrypoints produce equivalent results or the same typed refusal.
nonGoal: Does not let a fallback, memo hit, UI default, or adapter-specific option bypass policy or accounting.

name: durable-control-and-state
rationale: Leases, outbox delivery, restart recovery, pause/cancel, duplicate suppression, persisted counts, blockers, next actions, notifications, and portfolio isolation share the durable run state machine.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when kills and provider uncertainty resume exactly once, concurrent projects remain isolated, controls survive restart, and persisted whole-scope counts, costs, blockers, state, next action, and notifications never claim empty success.
nonGoal: Does not convert an operational blocker into a per-unit human queue or infer completion from a missing worker.

name: compatibility-and-studio-discovery
rationale: The data-driven compatibility report is consumed by authorized Studio search, navigation, deep links, action visibility, and catalog context; one registry/API/browser slice proves truthful display without duplicating family logic.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when all canonical rows disclose only observed operations and exact gaps, and authorized users can find and navigate account, project, locale, catalog, Wiki, runtime, review, evaluation, and export surfaces without stale, leaked, skipped, or cross-scope results.
nonGoal: Does not let detection, a placeholder status, cached search, or a visible action imply support or authority.

name: safe-runtime-proof-publication
rationale: Artifact hashing, retention, authorized resolution, redacted derivatives, tamper rejection, and content-free receipts are one shared publication boundary and are bundled with the first complete private capture that makes it observable.
acceptance: The named cell changes red to green when authorized private evidence resolves at full fidelity, public output is non-reconstructive, retention is enforced, and stale, missing, hash-mismatched, leaked, or self-authorized publication is rejected.
nonGoal: Does not weaken private evidence, publish run-derived private measurements, or trust a candidate-authored redaction.

name: whole-round-refinement-and-comparison
rationale: Scene and moment feedback, successor triggering, immutable parent recovery, causal lineage, and round comparison share API, database, Studio, and browser paths; removing unit mutation belongs in the same boundary-changing review.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when a human batches played-patch feedback into two successive immutable rounds, a seeded failure preserves the valid parent and unrelated hashes, comparisons explain exact causal changes, and no per-unit human edit or decision path remains.
nonGoal: Does not expose an inner-loop worklist, compare mutable snapshots, or let an agent originate round or export authority.

name: evaluation-and-confidence
rationale: Locked holdout construction, anonymous contestants, calibrated dimensions, validity attacks, durable reports, zero-call replay, backlog, and non-compensating readiness form one evaluation facility.
acceptance: Named cells change red to green when identical held-out work reproduces metrics, calibration, agreement, validity, bill and latency; seeded bias, leakage and meaning or voice defects invalidate comparison; and every required dimension independently gates readiness and an actionable next step.
nonGoal: Does not average away a failed dimension, compare unequal work, call providers during replay, or treat a transient report as evidence.

name: admitted-profile-intake-safety
rationale: For each registered or bounded production family, all concrete plain, protected, helper, container, and execution profiles must be admitted or refused through the same source boundary and hazard suite before decode work.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when every registered material profile prepares the complete immutable source or emits its exact typed refusal, while traversal, alias, collision, corruption, size, deadline, helper, secret, and unsupported-profile attacks leave no effect.
nonGoal: Does not infer a profile from an extension, expose secret or path data, or let one passing profile stand for another.

name: admitted-extraction-population
rationale: Family extraction and its field-population report must traverse the same selected members and normalized bundle; separating counts from extraction would permit a structurally green but empty producer.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when two independent lawful inputs yield complete stable units, speaker, choice, narrative, asset, protected-position and revision links, every configured member is accounted for, and each field reports nonempty over total or independently proved source absence.
nonGoal: Does not accept an empty bundle, silent member skip, synthetic substitution, or unclassified zero-valued field.

name: admitted-localization-patch-reproduction
rationale: Complete agent output, native writer preflight, atomic patching, re-extraction, and profile comparator are one source-to-patch transaction; together they prevent accepted normalized text from diverging from produced bytes.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when every required unit and asset receives an agent disposition, repair replaces the seeded draft, atomic native output re-extracts to accepted hashes, two clean runs meet the declared comparator, and mutation changes only its dependency cone.
nonGoal: Does not omit unresolved units, write partial output, tolerate undocumented nondeterminism, or substitute normalized text for patched bytes.

name: admitted-runtime-admission
rationale: Exact patched-byte launch, causal controls, checkpoint and route semantics, meaningful surfaces, and complete capture share one family runtime port and evidence envelope; splitting them would leave launch-only fragments.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when the exact patch launches, deterministic inputs and snapshots reproduce, bounded exploration labels coverage truthfully, changed text appears on every required surface, and complete frames, events, audio, checkpoints and counts bind to source, patch, session, and producer.
nonGoal: Does not promote a delegated, unavailable, start-only, static, substituted, or incomplete observation into runtime support.

name: admitted-played-export-journey
rationale: Exact production play, human authority, compatible export, full owned-release composition, profile measurements, and final qualification must share one immutable receipt chain; this is the completion boundary for each admitted family.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when an authorized human plays the exact produced patch, only that played compatible patch exports, two lawful titles complete intake through export, every registered profile reports bounded detection and operation evidence, and no missing lane, field, profile, receipt, or substituted leg qualifies.
nonGoal: Does not let one title, detection alone, an unplayed patch, a fixture leg, or another family's evidence establish production qualification.

name: new-profile-intake-safety
rationale: An unqualified target first needs a reviewed adapter-owned access profile, complete materialization, typed refusal surface, and destructive-input suite; this closes two cells while establishing no downstream support.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when reviewed concrete profiles prepare complete immutable owned input and every unknown, malformed, protected, helper, secret, traversal, size, timeout, cancellation, and corruption case refuses without effects.
nonGoal: Does not call detection extraction support, invent a universal profile, or consume a secret before profile and helper authorization.

name: new-extraction-population
rationale: A new family codec, normalized bridge, whole-scope accounting, source links, and real field census are one reviewable decode vertical and cannot be split into parser-only or report-only fragments.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when two independent lawful inputs traverse every selected member into complete normalized structure with reversible source evidence and per-field populated totals or independently proved absence.
nonGoal: Does not qualify detector output, a sample file, an empty bridge, or a census derived from expected rather than observed records.

name: new-localization-patch-reproduction
rationale: For a new family, accepted whole-scope localization, writer semantics, protected spans, atomic output, re-extraction, mutation isolation, and the right profile comparator form one native round-trip increment.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when the full agent loop covers every required unit, a repair reaches native output, writes are atomic and safe, re-extraction matches accepted identities and targets, and repeated or mutated runs satisfy the declared byte or semantic equivalence.
nonGoal: Does not finalize incomplete coverage, echo source text as success, patch a copy outside the transaction, or hide nondeterminism.

name: new-launch-control
rationale: A new family runtime needs exact patch binding, launch lifecycle, input semantics, clock, checkpoint, save, seek, and restore together before route or rendering work can claim causal execution.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when the exact patched artifact launches through the registered port and a recorded causal session reproduces controls, checkpoints and restored state while foreign source, patch, input, clock, snapshot, or delegated evidence is rejected.
nonGoal: Does not treat process start, static decode, native delegation, or an unbound snapshot as reproducible play.

name: new-routes-observation-admission
rationale: Typed branch actions, bounded traversal, rendering and audio sinks, source/target differential, capture artifacts, and completeness extend one new runtime port; the first admitted runtime supplies the shared envelope.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when bounded exploration reaches declared routes without overstating completion, intended text and assets appear on meaningful surfaces, and complete causal frames, events, audio, checkpoints and counts bind to the exact source, patch, profile and session.
nonGoal: Does not infer routes from static structure alone, count start as completion, or accept a missing or substituted observation.

name: new-played-export-journey
rationale: A newly implemented family becomes product support only when exact play, played export, full journey, two-title evidence, profile census, and bounded qualification close together after the first production vertical.
acceptance: Named family cells change red to green when an authorized human plays and exports the exact compatible patch, two independent lawful titles complete every product leg, every material profile reports bounded positive and negative evidence, and all private receipts resolve for the exact candidate.
nonGoal: Does not qualify a research note, detector, one title, start-only runtime, fixture substitution, or an export lacking its own play receipt.

name: bounded-role-conformance
rationale: Synthetic, benchmark, parity, research, and exclusion rows have explicit bounded outcomes only in the four canonical engine-shaped behaviors; one role-oracle conformance spec per row proves those outcomes without inventing product cells.
acceptance: Named row cells change red to green when the canonical role permits exactly its declared synthetic, comparison, research, or exclusion outcome for extraction, patch, launch and qualification, and every attempted production overclaim turns the same cells red.
nonGoal: Does not create localization, review, export, journey, safety-profile, or production-support cells absent from those non-production scenarios.
